items.title: Open Source Mac Os Apps Updates on Oct 30, 2026
items.content_text:
### ⏱️ Productivity (165) / ✏️ Text (19) * [akou (⭐14)](https://github.com/GeiserX/akou) - Records calls and meetings, transcribes them on-device with speaker labels, and lets Claude Code or Codex question a call over MCP. **Languages:** TypeScript Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

* [ParrotFlow (⭐22)](https://github.com/znat/parrotflow) - Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links. **Languages:** Swift Python **Website:**
Screenshots

* [littleguys (⭐39)](https://github.com/herval/littleguys) - WhatsApp-style app for talking to your AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and any ACP agent). **Languages:** Rust TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

* [WolfClip (⭐8)](https://github.com/RakushkaTOP/wolfclip) - Win+V style clipboard history with search, filters, pins and instant paste into the app you were typing in. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Posato (⭐5)](https://github.com/dees91/posato) - Blocks the websites and apps you choose for a timed pause, now or on a schedule, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync to iPhone through iCloud. **Languages:** kotlin Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🎵 Audio (72) * [JackMate (⭐6)](https://github.com/zinc75/JackMate) - JackMate is a native macOS app to start, configure and patch the JACK audio server, with a visual patchbay, saved studios and a menu bar mode. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📊 Menubar (177) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Local Transcriber (⭐11)](https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber) - Menu bar app that records meetings and calls and transcribes them locally with Whisper and pyannote speaker recognition, with dictation into any app. **Languages:** Swift Python **Website:**
Screenshots

* [TICS (⭐8)](https://github.com/yestoall/tics) - Menu bar app that plays mechanical keyboard sounds as you type, and mouse sounds as you click, drag and scroll. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Pullo (⭐5)](https://github.com/jordan-cod/pullo) - Your GitHub pull requests and Actions runs in the MacBook notch, with alerts when CI fails, a PR is approved or a review is requested. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 👨‍💻 Development (62) * [Alchemist Coder (⭐5)](https://github.com/Alekla0126/alchemist-coder) - Desktop app for Claude Code and Codex that shows every agent and subagent live, searches your coding-agent history and runs agents on local models. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📺 Terminal (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [tern (⭐56)](https://github.com/your-moon/tern) - Native SSH client written in Rust on GPUI, with saved hosts, a command picker, SFTP browser, split panes, port forwards and encrypted sync. **Languages:** Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

* [writui (⭐6)](https://github.com/aakashns/writui) - A terminal Markdown writing app with a local encrypted vault, automatic saving, and named versions. **Languages:** Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (235) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Cellar (⭐11)](https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar) - Homebrew manager for formulae, casks, and services that previews what brew will change before it runs. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar (⭐11)](https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar)
Screenshots

* [StableBar (⭐14)](https://github.com/Seb-GRAF/StableBar) - Customizable menu bar replacement with themes, widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [OS-intent (⭐8)](https://github.com/vdk888/os-intent) ![macOS 14.0++](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-14.0+%2B-blue) - Learns how you work and puts your likely next action one key away, with every outward action behind a confirm panel. **Languages:** Swift Python
Screenshots

* [Aman Check (⭐67)](https://github.com/MidZai/aman_check) - Dated, honest condition report for a used Mac: locks, battery, SSD and guided hardware tests. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🖼️ Images (23) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Siliconed (⭐14)](https://github.com/gwenn-ha-dev/Siliconed) - Local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, with Civitai LoRAs. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 💻 IDE (16) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Volt (⭐16)](https://github.com/LeulAria/VOLT) - Open-source AI code editor built on VS Code (Code - OSS) that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Kimi over ACP, with hunk-level keep/undo of agent edits. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### ⚙️ System (49) / ✏️ Text (19) * [FanPilot (⭐6)](https://github.com/zyvren/FanPilot) - Fan control and temperature monitor for Apple Silicon Macs, with Auto Boost rules, custom curves, a fail-safe helper and a CLI. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

### 🎬 Video (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Jutsu Studio (⭐23)](https://github.com/jutsuhq/jutsu-studio) - Unofficial Higgsfield client for creating AI videos and images with Seedance, Kling and Genjutsu, with every result kept on your disk. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Swapjutsu (⭐6)](https://github.com/jutsuhq/swapjutsu-seedance-character-swap) - Character swap for videos with Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate, with on-device preparation on Apple silicon. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### ⏱️ Productivity (165) / ✏️ Text (19) * [OLIV (⭐111)](https://github.com/chayapats/oliv) - Push-to-talk dictation for Thai mixed with English that runs Typhoon Whisper and Gemma on-device with MLX and types English tech words in English instead of Thai script. **Languages:** Swift Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

* [QuietSpeech (⭐0)](https://github.com/harshtomar6/quietspeech) - Push-to-talk dictation for Apple silicon that types into any app using Apple's on-device speech recognition and Apple Intelligence, with no API key. Paid app; source under GPLv3 (macOS 26+). **Languages:** Swift **Website:** * [Vauta (⭐0)](https://github.com/MaquinaTech/Vauta) - Meeting notes that stay on your Mac: transcribes any call on device and writes cited minutes, decisions and tasks. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [JUMP (⭐1)](https://github.com/alvaldes/jump) - Keyboard-driven navigation that labels every clickable element so you can click, scroll and search any app without the mouse. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [UMST (⭐10)](https://github.com/nicoleyangcoding/UMST-UltimateMacSchedulingTool) - Desktop calendar widget that shows Google, iCloud and Outlook calendars, Apple Reminders, Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle and other LMS deadlines, and Todoist, Asana and Trello tasks, with menu bar quick add. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

* [Anki Miner (⭐118)](https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner) - Desktop app for automated Anki language vocabulary card creation from video, audio, manga and books, in 32 languages. **Languages:** Python
Screenshots

### 📺 Terminal (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [ghostty-designer (⭐31)](https://github.com/reemus-dev/ghostty-designer) - Visual editor for Ghostty terminal themes, colours, fonts and window settings, with every change previewed live in your open terminals. **Languages:** Rust TypeScript
Screenshots

### 📊 Menubar (177) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Lumilo (⭐2)](https://github.com/kotuke/lumilo) - Menu bar app that runs Splash or llama.cpp servers, shows memory and token speed, and downloads models from Hugging Face. **Languages:** Go **Website:** [https://github.com/kotuke/lumilo (⭐2)](https://github.com/kotuke/lumilo)
Screenshots

* [mcpock (⭐3)](https://github.com/aka-kika/mcpock) - Menu bar app that checks every MCP server your AI agents use and shows which are broken, slow, waiting for a sign-in, or set up differently. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [TokenTracker (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker) - Local-first menu bar app and CLI that tracks AI token usage and estimated cost across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more without reading prompts. **Languages:** Swift TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

* [PullBull (⭐2)](https://github.com/rustycamper/pullbull) - GitHub pull requests, issues and Projects boards in the menu bar. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

* [Ghbdtn (⭐2)](https://github.com/skriptoff/Ghbdtn) - Menu bar app that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (English/Russian) with an Option+Command tap: converts the selection or the last word and switches the layout. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

### 🖼️ Images (23) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Pixtamer (⭐0)](https://github.com/heysidhant/pixtamer) - Batch convert, compress, resize and rename images into web-ready JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF, with responsive widths and presets. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (235) / ✏️ Text (19) * [AURA Switcher (⭐0)](https://github.com/klbk/aura-switcher-app) - Fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout right after Space; double Shift converts the last word. A Punto Switcher alternative. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** * [HideNotch (⭐33)](https://github.com/niklasravnsborg/HideNotch) - Paints the menu bar black on MacBooks with a notch, so the notch blends in, and can round the screen corners. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Çentik (⭐2)](https://github.com/YusufEmreYazici/Centik) - Turns the MacBook notch into a live island for music, system stats, an AI chat with your own Claude, Gemini or Ollama, clipboard history, a file shelf and meeting alerts. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/YusufEmreYazici/Centik (⭐2)](https://github.com/YusufEmreYazici/Centik)
Screenshots

### 🔒 Security (21) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Copy 2FA (⭐12)](https://github.com/stanczykwyatt/copy-2fa) - Copies the newest 2FA code from Mail or Messages with one shortcut, and includes a Touch ID authenticator for TOTP and HOTP codes. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🪟 Window Management (28) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Show Desktop (⭐5)](https://github.com/stanczykwyatt/show-desktop) - Hides every window with one click or a shortcut to show the Desktop, then brings them all back exactly as they were. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🎬 Video (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Content Factory (⭐2)](https://github.com/jutsuhq/content-factory) - Faceless video generator for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels: a script becomes a vertical video with AI frames, voiceover and subtitles. **Languages:** Python TypeScript Rust **Website:**
Screenshots
